name: MCPMark
intro: MCPMark 论文 v1 以五类 MCP 环境中的 38 个真实初始状态构建 127 个任务，每题由自然语言指令、初始状态和程序化验证器组成，并通过四阶段人机协作、专家与社区质控形成。评测在可恢复沙盒中运行工具调用循环，由任务专属 verify.py 检查最终状态及必要的输出证据。当前官方 MCPMark Verified 保留 127 个标准任务 ID，但已修改部分描述和验证器，并新增 50 个 easy 任务；其结果不可与论文原始任务版本直接比较。
org: NUS TRAIL, EvalSys, LobeHub, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Fudan University
build_method: 38 个初始状态策展, 四阶段人机协作, 验证器正反状态压测, 专家交叉复审与社区检查
metric: pass@1；四跑模型另报 pass@4 与 pass^4，已声明单跑模型仅报 pass@1
eval_feature: 沙盒状态恢复与重置, MCP 工具调用循环, 任务专属记录/输出解析, verify.py 退出码判定, 默认四次独立运行与已声明单跑例外
scale: 论文 v1：127 个任务 / 38 个初始状态；当前 Verified：127 个标准任务 + 50 个 easy 任务
build_method_en: 38-state curation, Four-stage Human-AI Co-design, Verifier Success/Failure Stress Tests, Expert Cross-review and Community Checks
eval_feature_en: Sandbox restore and reset, MCP tool loop, task-specific transcript/output parsing, verify.py exit-code judging, default four-run aggregation with declared single-run exceptions
intro_en: MCPMark paper v1 constructs 127 tasks from 38 realistic initial states across five MCP environments. Each task combines a natural-language instruction, an initial state, and a programmatic verifier produced through a four-stage human-AI workflow plus expert and community quality control. Evaluation runs a tool-calling loop in a restorable sandbox, and task-specific verify.py scripts inspect final state and output evidence when needed. The current official MCPMark Verified retains the 127 standard task IDs but changes some descriptions and verifiers and adds 50 easy tasks; its results are not directly comparable with the original paper task version.

drawio_review_note: Evidence boundary: arXiv:2509.24002v1 is the paper's only revision. The paper names no repository commit, so official release v1.2.0 at bc5f8382081eb88d95bb28ffcad9536d681d0426 is a declared nearest preprint-era reconstruction pin, not an asserted exact paper snapshot. Construction follows the paper's 38 initial states across Notion, GitHub, Filesystem, PostgreSQL, and Playwright; four human-AI stages (exploration, evolvement, verification, iteration); 10 experts spending 3–5 focused hours per task; correct/incorrect final-state stress tests; expert cross-review; a month-long community check; and extra validation of every task unsolved by all evaluated models. Paper-v1 inventory is 127 tasks: Filesystem 30, Notion 28, Playwright 25, GitHub 23, PostgreSQL 21; average instruction length is 288.6 words and average verifier length is 209.8 LOC. The public repository exposes description.md, meta.json, verify.py, agent/evaluation code under Apache-2.0, but runnable initial states span bundled, external, credentialed, and mixed-license sources documented in Appendix H. Evaluation restores a service-specific sandbox, exposes MCP tools through the MCP Python SDK and LiteLLM, stops the tool loop on a response with no tool calls, and caps an attempt at 100 turns / 3,600 seconds. execution.log and messages.json retain evidence; 18 of 127 standard verifiers inspect messages.json with task-specific last-assistant/output parsers, so there is no single global final-answer parser. verify.py runs even after an agent-reported failure; exit code 0 is the authoritative pass bit, while nonzero exits and exceptions fail; cleanup/reset follows verification. The default protocol uses four independent runs to produce a 127 x 4 success matrix, but Table 2 marks claude-opus-4.1 as a single-run model and the official aggregator supports single_run_models. Such models require one run per task, report pass@1 only, and have no pass@4 or pass^4; default four-run models report all three reliability metrics. Aggregation requires each model's expected service/task/run count and reports both all-task micro and per-service views. The paper reports GPT-5-medium at 52.56 ± 1.29 pass@1, 68.50 pass@4, and 33.86 pass^4; Table 9 gives it 14.71 average turns and 20.16 tool calls. The separate 16.2-turn and 17.4-tool-call figures are averages across evaluated LLMs, not GPT-5-medium usage. Current MCPMark Verified payload 84faaca88f418032c038f0f2e4ce1ed17b2f72b5 and HEAD cd45b7f57923b9b3985467f5139927575f83141c retain the same 127 standard IDs and add 50 easy tasks; relative to v1.2.0, repository audit finds 46 changed descriptions and 55 changed verify.py files. Verified pins Notion @1.9.1, GitHub MCP Server v0.15.0, Filesystem @2025.12.18, Playwright MCP 0.0.68, and postgres-mcp 0.3.0, and explicitly deprecates earlier results as not directly comparable.
